prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1255; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the accident. Let's leave my name out of it if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Baytown, Texas, where I was turning left off a main road onto a side street. It's a busy spot with a traffic signal.

Q: What was the signal showing when you began your turn?

A: It had turned yellow, and I was already in the intersection. I was waiting for oncoming traffic to clear before I went through.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other vehicle came through from the opposite direction and hit the front passenger side of my car. I didn't see it coming in time to react.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My neck and lower back hurt right away. I felt a stiffness that got worse over the next day or two.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some instructions for physical therapy.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, though it's a little better now. I still have trouble turning my head fully to the left and sitting for long periods bothers my lower back.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I've had to take a few shifts off, and I've been limiting how much I lift at work.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that I've been cooperative from the start and I'm happy to share my medical records and any photos I took at the scene.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
